section: Why Have You Only Come Now

conversation.speaker: dialogue
conversation.text:
Police: Why haven’t you reported it until now?
Respondent: 108 days.
Respondent: Xiyuan was by our side, breathing with us, for a total of 108 days.
Respondent: In those days... even just once...
Respondent: If we could hold her in our arms, kiss her cheeks, and feel her body temperature.
Respondent: Even if we could just hear her cry...
Respondent: Would that have made it... a little easier to bear?
Respondent: Xiyuan’s mother’s chest was still flowing with breast milk that had no owner.
Respondent: The place where Xiyuan once lay still retained her body warmth... lingering for a long time.
Respondent: How could I... how could I personally...
Respondent: I kept thinking.
Respondent: It must be because of the name...
Respondent: It was the name.
Respondent: I shouldn’t have given her that name. I blamed myself for a long time because of it.
Respondent: I originally named her that in the hope that she would be as strong as a rhinoceros, but instead she left alone like a rhinoceros horn...
Respondent: Severing all ties and afflictions.
Respondent: With no attachment and no longing, like a gust of wind...
